run_sample_metaquery: run the MetaQueryPipeline to generate 4 images from a text prompt using a checkpoint
run_main_sampling: run the main function to sample images from a dataset folder and save grids
run_cli_sampling: run the CLI module with --dataset_folder and --checkpoint_path to generate image grids
review_sample_metaquery: review the sample_metaquery function that calls the pipeline with caption, guidance_scale, and inference steps
review_main_pipeline: review the main function that loads a pretrained pipeline and saves 2x2 image grids
